//: Mirrors kandev's .claude/settings.json (github.com/kdlbs/kandev): format every file the agent writes, immediately, in the same PostToolUse shape. kandev runs prettier for JS/TS and gofmt for Go; this repo has one formatter for everything, so both matchers call biome. Note what is NOT here: kandev ships no `permissions` block either — its agent's permission bypass is a per-profile CLI flag at launch, not a checked-in allowlist.

hooks.command: f="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css) root=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$root" ] && (cd "$root" && bunx biome check --write "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1) ;; esac
